instruction: Search for hybrid vehicles for sale near ZIP code 02101, staying within a 40-mile radius and a $30,000 budget.

metadata.explanation: Variation 4: Changed to search for hybrid vehicles in Boston area (ZIP 02101 instead of 10001), with lower price cap ($30,000 instead of $50,000), and different search radius (40 miles instead of 50). Uses the same evaluator logic - parsing URL query parameters. No custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all 4 instruction requirements: ZIP code (02101), price limit ($30,000), distance range (40 miles), and fuel type (hybrid)
Getter logic (get_active_tab_url_parse) correctly extracts URL query parameters from the active tab using accessibility tree, which is a reliable OSWorld pattern
Parse keys (list_price_max, maximum_distance, zip, fuel_slugs[]) correctly map to cars.com URL parameters for the required filters

Expected values semantically match instruction requirements: list_price_max='30000' for $30k budget, maximum_distance='40' for 40-mile range, zip='02101' for Boston area, fuel_slugs[]='hybrid' for hybrid cars
Metric function (check_direct_json_object) performs exact key-by-key comparison between extracted URL params and expected values, which is appropriate for this verification
Complete coverage - all instruction requirements are verified by the evaluator
No state timing issues - URL is stable once navigation to search results completes
No edge case concerns - URL parsing is deterministic and the getter reads directly from Chrome's address bar
